# Metrica Master Services Agreement

## Data Use

Provider may process Customer Data only to provide the services and support.

Provider may not sell Customer Data.

## Liability Cap

Aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the prior 12 months.

The cap does not apply to confidentiality obligations, security breach indemnity, or payment obligations.

## Assignment

Assignment requires prior written consent except in connection with a merger or sale of substantially all assets.
